description.content:
Upload chat mutations when Cloud Sync is enabled.

Referenced meetings are validated up front, so a missing or unowned meeting
rejects the entire batch before any write. Each chat then commits
independently; a mid-batch conflict can leave earlier chats persisted.
Clients should retry the whole batch because revisions are idempotent.

Args:
    body: Batch of chat mutations to upload.
    user: Authenticated owner of the chats and referenced meetings.
    db:   Main database executor used for meeting validation.

Returns:
    Acknowledgements for every successfully applied chat mutation.

Raises:
    HTTPException:
        403: Cloud Sync is disabled.
        404: A referenced meeting is missing or not owned by the caller.
        409: A chat mutation conflicts with canonical state.
